accountConnect.account: Binciken jama'a yana buƙatar babu asusu. Haɗa asusunka na DeHub don sarrafa bayanin martaba da ƙirƙirar ko buga abun ciki.
accountConnect.body: Haɗa asusunka don gudanar da bayanin martaba, buga sakonni da ƙirƙirar abun ciki daga hira. Haɗin haɗi yana ƙare a cikin awanni 24. Kuna iya cire haɗin kai a kowane lokaci.

accountConnect.intro: Browse DeHub a cikin ChatGPT, ko haɗa asusunka don sabunta bayaninka, buga sakonni da amfani da Creator Studio. Ƙara https://dehub.io/mcp a matsayin mai haɗa OAuth don sarrafa asusun.

accountConnect.read: Kara takardar muku, wallafe-wallafe, bayanan bayanan da kibecin Creator.
accountConnect.social: Kirkira takardu da labarai, kada ayyuka da kada abokin hulda, da kada takarda.
accountConnect.step: Don sarrafa asusun, ƙara https://dehub.io/mcp a matsayin mai haɗa OAuth, shiga cikin DeHub kuma sake duba izini kafin ba da damar samun dama.
accountConnect.title: Haɗa asusunka na DeHub
accountConnect.what: Browse jama'a posts da bayanan martaba. Tare da haɗin asusun OAuth, sarrafa bayaninka da sirrinka, buga sakonni da sharhi, bi mutane, karanta sanarwa, adana alamun littafi da kuma samar da hotuna, bidiyo, sauti da kadarorin 3D. Generation yana amfani da dokokin biyan kuɗi na DeHub na yanzu.

raffle.howBody: Matakai huɗu, a wannan tsari, kowane lokaci. Sashen da ke yanke hukunci kan wanda ya yi nasara yana faruwa a fili.
raffle.step1Body: Kowace zabuka tana buɗewa da kyautarta, lokacin rufewarta, da kuma hanyoyin da suka dace don samun shiga, ana bugawa a cikin app kuma ana liƙawa a cikin abincin.
raffle.step2Body: Ana samun shiga ta hanyar yin abubuwan da kuke yi a DeHub. Sanarwar tana jera ayyukan da suka dace don wannan zabuka da kuma adadin shiga da kowannensu ke da daraja.
raffle.step3Body: A lokacin rufewa, jerin shiga ana ɗaukar hoto kuma ana zana lambar nasara daga tushen bazuwar dama a kan-chain, ba daga takardar lissafi ba.
raffle.step4Body: Hoto, mu'amala, da kuma shigarwar nasara duk suna fitowa tare, don haka kowa zai iya sake duba sakamakon maimakon ya yarda da maganarmu.
raffle.entriesTitle: Ana samun shiga, ba a saya ba
raffle.entriesBody: An tsara zabuka don masu amfani da DeHub. Kowace sanarwa tana bayyana hanyoyin da suka dace don ita. Waɗannan su ne waɗanda zabuka ke ginawa akai.
raffle.postBody: Buga asali, bidiyo da kuma comments suna kirga don zane-zane da ke ambaton su.
raffle.stakeBody: Wani matsayi na staking da aka buɗe yana samun shigarwa don zane-zane da ke lissafa shi.
raffle.arcadeBody: Sesshin na wurin wasa da kuma matsayi a kan leaderboard suna ciyar da zane-zane da aka gina a kusa da wasanni.
raffle.stagesBody: Zuwa ga matakan sauti kai tsaye yana kirga, ko kuna magana ko sauraro.
raffle.ticketBody: Wasu zane-zane kuma suna sayar da tikiti da aka biya a cikin token na DeHub. Inda suke yi, farashin da iyakar kowane walat ana bugawa a gaba.
raffle.collectibleBody: Zaɓin tarin NFT suna ɗaukar shigarwa na tsawon lokaci a cikin zane-zane da ke ambaton su.
raffle.fairnessTitle: Me yasa za a iya amincewa da sakamakon
raffle.fairnessBody: Raffle yana da daraja shiga ne kawai idan mai gudanarwa ba zai iya zaɓar wanda ya ci ba a hankali. Abubuwa uku suna sa hakan ta zama gaskiya anan.
raffle.fair1Body: Jerin shigarwa ana ɗaukar hoto a lokacin rufewa da aka ambata kuma ana buga shi kafin zane ya gudana. Babu abin da za a iya ƙarawa a gare shi bayan haka, har da mu.
raffle.fair2Body: Sakamakon mai nasara yana fitowa ne a kan sarkar, don haka lambar da ke yanke shawarar zane tana wanzuwa a cikin ciniki na jama'a maimakon a cikin kayan aiki na ciki.
raffle.fair3Title: Duk sakamakon za a iya duba shi
raffle.fair3Body: Hoton, hash na ciniki da kuma shigarwa mai nasara ana buga su a matsayin ɗaya. Sake gudanar da lissafin daga bayanan jama'a dole ne ya kai ga wanda ya ci nasara iri ɗaya.
raffle.neverPayTitle: DeHub ba zai taɓa tambayarka ku biya don sakin kyauta ba
raffle.neverPayBody: An ambaci masu nasara a cikin app da kuma a cikin sakamakon jama'a. Babu wanda daga DeHub zai tuntube ku don kuɗi, kalmar sirri, maɓallin sirri ko sa hannun walat don bayar da kyauta. Duk wani saƙo da ke yin haka yana zamba ne. Rahoton shi kuma ku goge shi.
raffle.faqBody: Waɗanda muke tambaya akai-akai game da zane-zane, shigarwa da kyaututtuka.
raffle.faq1Q: Shin dole ne in saya wani abu don shiga zane kyautar DeHub?
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: A'a. Kowace zane tana da akalla hanyar shiga kyauta ɗaya, wanda ake samu ta hanyar shiga cikin DeHub. Wasu zane-zane kuma suna sayar da tikiti da aka biya a cikin token na DeHub, amma tikiti ba shine kawai hanyar shiga ba.
raffle.faq2Q: Ta yaya zan san cewa zane ba a gyara shi ba?
raffle.faq2A: Ana ɗaukar hoto na jerin shigarwa kuma ana buga shi kafin zane ya gudana, kuma ana fitar da lambar mai nasara daga tushen randomness na kan sarkar. Ana buga hoton, ciniki da kuma shigarwa mai nasara tare don haka kowa zai iya sake lissafin sakamakon.
raffle.faq3Q: Yaya ake sanar da masu nasara?
raffle.faq3A: Ana sanar da masu nasara a cikin app kuma ana ambaton su a cikin sakamakon. Babu imel da ke neman biya, kalmar sirri ko sa hannun walat. DeHub ba zai taɓa neman ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan don bayar da kyauta ba.
raffle.faq4A: Kwanaki goma sha huɗu daga lokacin da aka buga sakamakon. Kyaututtukan Token suna zuwa walat ɗin DeHub na wanda ya ci nasara akan Base. Ana shirya kyaututtukan jiki kai tsaye tare da ƙungiyar, kuma ana rufe jigilar kaya inda za mu iya jigilar kaya bisa doka.
raffle.faq5A: Duk wanda ke da asusun DeHub wanda ya wuce 18 kuma yana zaune a wani wuri zane ya halatta. Ma'aikatan DeHub, 'yan kwangila da iyalansu ba su cancanci ba, kuma zane-zane ba su da banza inda dokar gida ta haramta su.
raffle.faq6Q: Sau nawa ne zanawa ke gudana?
raffle.faq6A: Babu tsayayyen jadawalin. Zane-zane suna da alaƙa da ƙaddamarwa, milestones da kamfen na abokin tarayya, kuma an sanar da kowannensu a cikin aikace-aikacen lokacin da ya buɗe.
raffle.ctaTitle: Zane suna gudana a cikin DeHub
raffle.ctaBody: Duk abin da ke rayuwa yanzu an sanar da shi a cikin abincin ku. Kunna sanarwar don haka na gaba ba ya wuce ku.
raffle.readAboutTokens: Karanta game da token na DeHub
raffle.legal: Zaben kyaututtuka na talla ne kuma a buɗe ga masu asusun DeHub masu shekaru 18 ko fiye, babu inganci inda doka ta ƙasa ta haramta su. Ma’aikatan DeHub, kwangiloli da iyalansu ba su cancanta ba. Ba za a iya musanya kyaututtuka da kuɗi ba sai an bayyana, kuma kowanne sanarwar zabe tana ɗauke da cikakken sharuɗɗanta.

screens.glossaryMintTxDesc: Taɓa alamar bayani a kan sakon da aka yi minting ɗinsa don buɗe cinikin minting ɗinsa a mai binciken toshe kuma ka tabbatar da rikodin da ke kan sarkar. Cikakken shafin Bayanin Sako — ƙididdiga, masu riƙewa, kasuwa — yana kan manhajar yanar gizo a dehub.io.
screens.glossaryTokenIdDesc: Keɓaɓɓen mai ganowa a kan sarkar da ake ba sako lokacin da aka yi minting ɗinsa a matsayin NFT.
screens.walletSubtitle: Gudanar da jimlar kuɗin DeHub ɗinku
screens.glossaryTipDesc: Aiko da jimlar kuɗin DeHub kai tsaye ga mai ƙirƙirar abun ciki a matsayin lada ga abun cikin su. An yi rikodin kyaututtuka a kan sarkar.
screens.glossaryPpvDesc: Abun ciki na Premium wanda ke buƙatar biyan kuɗi a cikin jimlar DeHub don buɗewa. Masu ƙirƙirar suna saita farashin kuma suna samun kuɗi daga kowane kallo.
screens.glossaryDhbTokenDesc: DHB shine alamar kasuwanci don jimlar DeHub, jimlar amfani ta asali ta DeHub. Ana amfani da shi don ba da kyauta, biyan kuɗi-per-kallo, zaɓen gudanarwa, da saka.
screens.glossaryWalletDesc: Walat ɗin ku na kan sarkar wanda ke riƙe da jimlar kuɗin DeHub da sauran kadarorin crypto. An haɗa ta ta hanyar Web3Auth don sauƙin shiga.
screens.glossaryStakingDesc: Saka jimlar kuɗin DeHub ɗinku don samun lada akan lokaci. Jimlar kuɗi da aka saka kuma suna ba ku ƙarfin jefa ƙuri'a a cikin gudanarwa.
screens.glossaryGovernanceDesc: Saka hannun jari da jefa ƙuri'a kan shawarwarin da ke tsara dandalin. Ƙarfin jefa ƙuri'a ku yana da nauyi ta yawan jimlar kuɗin DeHub da kuke riƙe.
screens.glossaryStakingBadgesDesc: Badges da aka nuna kusa da sunan mai amfani ku dangane da jimlar kuɗin DeHub ɗinku (walat + saka). Akwai matakai 13 — mafi yawan kuɗi da kuke riƙe, mafi girman matsayin badge ɗin ku. Manyan matakai suna ba da ƙarfin jefa ƙuri'a na gudanarwa da kuma ƙananan kuɗin dandalin.
screens.glossaryLeaderboardDesc: Ana sanya masu amfani a cikin tsari ta jimlar kuɗin DeHub (walat + saka a duk sassa). Rankings suna sabuntawa lokaci-lokaci kuma suna lura da canje-canje na kwana 1 da makonni 1. Hakanan zaka iya tsara ta ta kyaututtuka da aka aika, kyaututtuka da aka karɓa, masu bi, abubuwan so, ko masu biyan kuɗi.

Adadin DeHub shine ainihin kuɗin shigar ku na gudummawa da aka canza a farashin token na rayuwa, kuma bai haɗa da biyan kuɗi, PPV da tallace-tallace na kantin sayar da kayayyaki ba. feedback.intro: Kun yi amfani da DeHub na waje? Gaya mana abin da ya kasance. Kyau, mummuna ko takaici - duk shi ana karantawa. Idan kun yi farin ciki don mu yi amfani da cikakken magana naka, bugi akwatin kuma kila mu yi amfani da shi a jigogin jiya, bidiyo ko a gida.

solana.unavailableTitle: Walat ɗin Solana ba ya samuwa
solana.unavailableBody: Wannan na'urar ba ta riƙe maɓallin walat ɗin DeHub naka ba. Sake shiga don dawo da shi, walat ɗin Solana naka kuma zai dawo tare da shi.
solana.fundingBody: Yin sakonni, ba da kyauta da buɗe abun ciki a Solana duk ana biyan su daga wannan adireshin. Aika masa SOL daga wata kasuwa ko wata walat — kusan 0.01 SOL ya isa sakonni da yawa. An samo shi daga walat ɗin DeHub naka, don haka yana dawowa a duk na'urar da ka shiga.
solana.mintingOff: An kashe yin sakonni a Solana a uwar garken yanzu. Walat ɗinka da ma'aunin ka ba su shafa ba.
solana.legacyBody: Wani tsohon sigar manhajar ya ƙirƙiri walat ɗin Solana daban wanda ya wanzu a wannan na'urar kawai. Har yanzu yana da kuɗi. Matsar da kuɗin zuwa adireshin da ke sama yayin da kake da wannan wayar — ba a iya dawo da wannan maɓallin a wani wuri ba.

walletSetup.tryBiometricsHint: Yi amfani da wannan idan ka saita wannan walat ɗin a wannan wayar kuma ya kamata maɓallin ya riga ya kasance a nan
walletSetup.connectWalletApp: Sa hannu da manhajar walat ɗin da yake ciki
walletSetup.signOutAndStartOver: Ba ni da shi — fita ka sake farawa
walletSetup.restoreLocalNote: Maɓallin yana zama a wannan wayar kawai.
walletSetup.restoreMissing: Walat ɗin wannan bayanin ba ya cikin wannan wayar, don haka ba za a iya sa hannu kan komai ba tukuna. Shigar da jimlar dawo da shi ko maɓallin sirrinsa don kawo shi nan.
walletSetup.noPhraseNoKey: Babu jimla kuma babu maɓalli? To wannan walat sai daga na'urar da ta ƙirƙira shi ake iya buɗe shi — babu abin da ke shafin ko a gefenmu da zai dawo da shi. Shiga a kan wannan na'urar idan har yanzu kana da ita.
walletSetup.resetExplainer: Wannan yana ba shigarka sabon walat mara komai, kuma yana matsar da asusunka zuwa gare shi. Ba ya buɗe tsohon walat — wannan wayar ba za ta iya ba, dehub.io ba zai iya ba, mu ma ba za mu iya ba — don haka duk abin da ke ciki zai kasance a can.
walletSetup.checkingWaysBack: Muna duba ko kana da wata hanya ta dawowa cikin wannan walat…
walletSetup.mayGetItBack: Wataƙila har yanzu za ka iya dawo da wannan walat
walletSetup.couldNotSecure: An kasa tabbatar da tsaron walat ɗinka
walletSetup.couldNotRestore: An kasa dawo da wannan walat
walletSetup.couldNotCopy: An kasa kwafi — maimakon haka rubuta kalmomin.
walletSetup.couldNotFinishSetup: An kasa kammala saitin wannan asusun. Sake gwadawa.
walletSetup.couldNotStartOver: An kasa fara sabo. Ba a canja komai ba.
walletSetup.securingWallet: Muna tabbatar da tsaron walat ɗinka — a wasu na'urori wannan na iya ɗaukar kusan minti ɗaya…
walletSetup.unlockingWallet: Muna buɗe walat ɗinka — a wasu na'urori wannan na iya ɗaukar kusan minti ɗaya…
walletSetup.profileWalletLabel: Walat ɗin bayanan martaba na DeHub
walletSetup.understandOldWalletA11y: Na fahimci cewa tsohon walat, da duk abin da ke ciki, ba zan iya kaiwa gare shi ba
walletSetup.protectWallet: Don tabbatar da cewa kai kaɗai za ka iya wallafawa ko yin ciniki da wannan asusun, ka kare walat ɗinka da biometrics na na'urarka ko kalmar sirri.
walletSetup.ifYouUsedDehub: Idan ka taɓa amfani da dehub.io a baya, buɗe shi a kwamfutarka, ka shiga ta hanya ɗaya kuma da asusu ɗaya, sannan
walletSetup.biometricExplainer: Buɗe da yatsan hannunka ko fuskarka — babu abin da za a buga ko a tuna. Maɓallin yana zama a wannan wayar, don haka za mu nuna maka jimlar dawo da asusu ta kalmomi 12 don ka rubuta; ita ce kaɗai hanyar dawowa daga wata waya, daga shafin yanar gizo, ko bayan sake girkawa. Zaɓi Kalmar sirri maimakon haka, sai kalmar sirrin ta yi wannan aikin.
walletSetup.biometricExplainerSecuring: Buɗe da yatsan hannunka ko fuskarka — babu abin da za a buga ko a tuna. Maɓallin yana zama a wannan wayar. Don dawowa daga wata waya, daga shafin yanar gizo, ko bayan sake girkawa, ka adana madadin kalmomi 12 daga baya a Saituna. Zaɓi Kalmar sirri maimakon haka, sai kalmar sirrin ta yi wannan aikin.
walletSetup.biometricPrompt: Wannan walat ɗin yana da kariya ta biometrics na wannan na'urar. Tabbatar da yatsa ko fuska don ci gaba.
walletSetup.enterRecoveryPhrase: Shigar da jimlar dawo da asusu ta kalmomi 12 da ka ajiye lokacin da ka ƙirƙiri wannan walat (ko maɓallinsa na sirri, idan ka fitar da shi). Yana komawa zuwa asusu ɗaya, kuma kalmar sirrin da za ka saita a ƙasa ta zama madadin da ke aiki ko'ina daga yanzu.
walletSetup.addedPasswordRetry: Na ƙara kalmar sirri — sake gwadawa
walletSetup.lostPhraseToo: Na rasa jimlar ma — fara sabo
walletSetup.neverUsedDehub: Ban taɓa amfani da dehub.io ba — fara sabo
walletSetup.recoveryPhraseLabel: Jimlar dawo da asusu ko maɓallin sirri
walletSetup.resetAndCreate: Sake saiti kuma ƙirƙiri sabon walat
walletSetup.thatsGoneToo: Wannan ma ya ɓace — duk da haka fara sabo
walletSetup.confirmStartOver: Tabbatar kana son fara sabo da sabon walat
walletSetup.understandOldWallet: Na fahimci cewa tsohon walat, da duk abin da ke ciki, zai fita daga hannuna har abada
walletSetup.legacyRecovered: Mun tabbatar da tsohon asusunka{{suffix}} kuma mun dawo da walat ɗinsa. Saita kalmar sirri don kare shi a wannan na'urar — a wannan wayar da ko'ina, daga yanzu.
walletSetup.deviceCheckCancelled: An soke duba na'ura — babu abin da aka canza.
walletSetup.recoveryRecordNotice: Wannan asusun yana da rikodin mayya daga dehub.io. Lambar mayya mai kalmomi 24 da aka ba ku har yanzu tana buɗe wannan walat ɗin. Bude dehub.io akan kwamfuta, shiga ta hanya guda kuma da asusun guda, kuma yi amfani da wannan lambar — tana dawo da walat ɗin, da kuma asusunka, daidai yadda suke.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeSingle: Wannan asusun yana da buɗewar kalmar sirri da aka yi rajista akan dehub.io. A cikin burauzar da ke riƙe da shi, dehub.io har yanzu yana iya buɗe wannan walat ɗin.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeMultiple: Wannan asusun yana da fiye da buɗewar kalmar sirri ɗaya da aka yi rajista akan dehub.io. A cikin burauzar da ke riƙe da kowannensu, dehub.io har yanzu yana iya buɗe wannan walat ɗin.
walletSetup.otherWaysCheckFailed: Ba a iya duba ko kuna da wasu hanyoyi na komawa wannan walat ɗin ba. Idan kun taɓa saita lambar mayya ko kalmar sirri akan dehub.io, ku je ku gwada hakan da farko — ci gaba anan yana share su.
walletSetup.loseFundsHead: Duk abin da tsohon walat ɗin ke riƙe da shi.
walletSetup.loseFundsBody: Salalonsu suna kasancewa {{address}}akan blockchain — babu abin da aka kashe ko aka ɗauka — amma motsa su yana buƙatar kalmar mayya ko maɓallin sirri na wannan walat ɗin. Ba tare da ɗaya ba, babu wanda zai iya samunsu: ba ku ba, ba mu ba. Sai dai idan za ku iya fitar da maɓallin daga na'urar da ta ƙirƙira shi, ku yi la'akari da abin da ke ciki a matsayin abin da ya ɓace.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryBody: An share rikodin mayya akan dehub.io a matsayin wani ɓangare na wannan, don haka wannan hanyar tana rufewa.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryUnknownBody: Idan kun taɓa saita lambar mayya mai kalmomi 24 akan dehub.io, an share ta a matsayin wani ɓangare na wannan. Ba mu iya duba ko kuna da ɗaya ba.
walletSetup.losePasskeysBody: An cire kalmomin sirri da aka yi rajista akan dehub.io a matsayin wani ɓangare na wannan.
walletSetup.losePasskeysUnknownBody: An cire duk kalmomin sirri da aka yi rajista akan dehub.io a matsayin wani ɓangare na wannan. Ba mu iya duba ko kuna da kowannensu ba.
walletSetup.keepAccountBody: Sunan mai amfani, bayanin martaba, sakonni, sharhi, masu bi, lambobi da tarihi duk suna motsawa zuwa sabon walat ɗin. Yana da asusun guda — babu wanda zai sake neman ku.
walletSetup.keepMessagesBody: Tattaunawa, sanarwa, alamomi, sakonni da aka adana da tarihin kallo suna tare da ku. Babu abin da aka goge kuma babu wanda zai iya karanta kowane ɗayansu.
walletSetup.keepSignInBody: Lambar waya guda, imel ko asusun Google, taɓawa ɗaya guda. Walat ɗin da ke bayan shiga ne ake maye gurbin shi, ba shiga ba.
walletSetup.checkDeviceHead: Duba na'urar da ka saita shi a kai.
walletSetup.checkDeviceBody: Waya tana riƙe da kwafin maɓallin yayin da DeHub ke shigarwa, kuma burauza tana riƙe da kalmar sirrin ta. Idan har yanzu kuna da ɗaya daga cikinsu, ku je can, ku fitar da maɓallin sirri, ku dawo ku yi amfani da Maido da shi maimakon — hakan yana riƙe da salalolin ma.
walletSetup.passwordBreached: Wannan kalmar sirri ta bayyana a cikin wani data breach — zaɓi wata dabam
walletSetup.phraseInvalidHint: Wannan bai dace da kalmar mayya ba — kalmomi 12, a tsarin da aka nuna, duk ƙananan haruffa.
walletSetup.privateKeyHint: Maɓallin sirri shine haruffa 64 na hex bayan 0x.
walletSetup.noUsableBackup: Wannan asusun yana da adireshin walat a kan fayil, amma babu madogara da wannan wayar za ta iya amfani da ita — ko dai an kare shi da biometrics ko kalmar sirri a yanar gizo (wancan buɗewar yana zama a cikin burauzar kuma baya haɗawa anan), ko kuma wani farkon shiga akan wannan wayar ya katse kafin ya gama.
walletSetup.addPasswordOnWeb: Idan kun taɓa amfani da dehub.io a baya, ku buɗe shi akan kwamfutarka, ku shiga ta hanya guda kuma da asusun guda, kuma ƙara kalmar sirrin walat — hakan yana adana madogara mai ɓoye a cikin girgije. Sannan ku dawo nan ku sake gwadawa.
walletSetup.biometricKeepsFailing: {{error}} Idan wannan ya ci gaba da kasa, yi amfani da kalmar sirri ta wallet ɗinka a ƙasa ko "Import external wallet".
walletSetup.deviceBoundKey: Wannan wallet ɗin yana buɗewa tare da biometrics da ke kan wata na'ura ta musamman — wayar ko burauzar da aka saita ta. Wannan wayar ba ta da wannan maɓalli, kuma dehub.io ba shi da shi: maɓallin ba ya barin na'urar da ta yi shi.
walletSetup.unlockPasskeyOnly: An amintar da wannan wallet ɗin tare da kalmar sirri a yanar gizo kuma ba shi da madogara ta kalmar sirri a girgije tukuna. Idan ka saita kalmar sirri ta wallet a dehub.io, shigar da ita anan — in ba haka ba yi amfani da Import external wallet a ƙasa.
walletSetup.unlockWithPasswordExplainer: Wannan asusun yana da wallet a yanzu, wanda kalmar sirri ke karewa. Shigar da ita don dawo da wallet ɗinka a wannan na'urar.
walletSetup.deviceExplainer: Babu wani abu da za a rubuta ko tuna — maɓallin ya kasance a kan wannan na'urar. Za mu ba ku madadin kalmomi 12 don rubutawa; ita ce kawai hanyar dawowa daga wani na'ura, daga gidan yanar gizon, ko bayan sake shigarwa. Zaɓi Kalmar wucewa maimakon kuma kalmar sirri kanta tana yin wannan aikin.
walletSetup.deviceExplainerSecuring: Babu abin da za a buga ko a tuna — maɓallin yana zama a wannan na'urar. Don dawowa daga wata na'ura, daga shafin yanar gizo, ko bayan sake girkawa, ka adana madadin kalmomi 12 daga baya a Saituna. Zaɓi Kalmar sirri maimakon haka, sai kalmar sirrin ta yi wannan aikin.
walletSetup.secureOnDevice: Ci gaba da maɓallin a kan wannan na'urar

commonGround.title: Dandali na gama gari
commonGround.sheetHint: Jinkiri kaɗan kafin amsa ku. Amsa ku ba ta bayyana ga kowa.
commonGround.toggleHint: Kafin amsa ta farko, ana tambayar masu karatu game da mafi muhimmancin batu na ɓangaren gaba da kuma abin da dukkan ɓangarorin ke da shi, sannan a tunatar da su su guji tunanin ko dai-ko-wannan.
commonGround.banner: Wannan mai ƙirƙirar ya kunna yanayin Dandali na gama gari. Kafin ka amsa za a tambaye ka game da mafi muhimmancin batu na ɓangaren gaba da kuma abin da kuke da shi tare.
commonGround.step1Title: A jumla ɗaya, menene mafi muhimmancin batu a ɓangaren gaba?
commonGround.step1Placeholder: Mafi kyawun abin da za su iya faɗi shine cewa…
commonGround.step2Title: Me kuke da su tare da su da gaske kuke yarda a kai?
commonGround.reminderTitle: Yi hankali da tunanin ko dai-ko-wannan
commonGround.reminderBody: Yawancin rashin jituwa ba zaɓi ne tsakanin abubuwa biyu masu tsattsauran ra'ayi ba. Lokacin da tambaya ta zama kamar ko dai-ko-wannan, yawanci akwai wata hanya ta uku a tsakiya.
commonGround.example1: Maƙwabci wanda yake son titin ya yi tsit da maƙwabci wanda yake son wurin ajiye mota na ƙarin motoci dukansu za su iya zama daidai game da abin da suke bukata.
commonGround.example2: Iyaye biyu za su iya rashin jituwa game da lokacin amfani da allo kuma har yanzu su yarda cewa yaron ya kamata ya yi barci sosai kuma ya yi kyau a makaranta.
commonGround.noShouting: Abubuwa masu rikitarwa ba sa samun mafita ta hanyar kururuwa ko barazana. Amsa mai nutsuwa, takamaimi ita ce wadda mutane ke karantawa da gaske.
commonGround.privateNote: Amsa ku ta ku kaɗai ce kuma ba a buga ta tare da amsa ku ba.
commonGround.tooShort: Rubuta aƙalla haruffa 10 don tunani ya ƙidaya da gaske.
commonGround.saveFailed: An kasa adana saitin Dandali na gama gari. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.

export.documentImageHint: Babban daki-daki yana kiyaye hotunan shafi mafi girma. Fayiloli mafi kankanta suna rage girman hoto da ingancin JPEG. Ana kiyaye girman shafi da hanyoyin sadarwa.
export.rangeHint: Kiyaye captions da sauti ga kowane yanke. Kowane fayil yana ƙara 2.2 seconds DeHub ƙarewa. Fayilolin da yawa suna saukewa tare azaman ZIP.
export.archiveTooLarge: Saukewa ya wuce 512 MiB. Fitarwa ƙananan shirye-shiryen bidiyo ko zaɓi ƙananan ƙuduri.
export.gifHint: Madauki animation ba tare da sauti ba. Har zuwa 60 seconds, 640 pixels da 15 fps. Ya haɗa da ƙarshen tambarinku.
export.gifTooLong: Trim da lokaci line zuwa 60 seconds ko žasa, ko zabi MP4 ko WebM.
export.empty: Da farko ƙara wani abu a zane naka.
export.cropMarkHint: Ƙara alamun yankewa a waje da zane-zane. A ajiye buga ƙuduri saita gama page size.
export.cropMarks: Alamar amfanin gona da kuma buga margins
export.filenameHint: Bar blank ga tsoho sunayen. Yi amfani da {title}, {name}, {section}, {page}, ko {page:3}. Ƙara prefix kamar yadda m rubutu. Duplicate sunayen samun wani page-number suffix.
export.jpegQualityHint: Inganci mafi ƙanƙanta yawanci yana samar da fayiloli masu ƙanƙanta. Girman pixel yana nan yadda yake; zane-zane masu cikakken bayani na iya nuna matsewa.
export.notesTextHint: Zazzage taken sashe, lambobin shafi na asali, sunayen shafi, da kuma bayanin kula mai gabatarwa azaman fayil ɗin rubutu.
export.pageOrderHint: Shafuna suna bin umarnin da aka shigar. Yi amfani da 3,1-2 don farawa da shafi na 3, ko 5-1 don juya kewayon. Lambobin shafi da aka maimaita suna bayyana sau ɗaya.
export.pptxHint: Kowane shafi ya zama hoton zamewa guda ɗaya, tare da bayanan mai gabatarwa da hanyoyin haɗi. Shirya rubutun mutum da abubuwa a cikin zane na asali.

bulk.tokenHint: Manna mai saka wuri a cikin rubutun samfuri ko abun ciki na QR kuma zaɓi Yi amfani da masu sanya wuri a cikin rubutu don wannan Layer. Formatting ganye spreadsheet dabi'u ba canza. Lissafi Formats bukatar bayyanannu lambobi; 25 Formats kamar yadda 25% a cikin kashi yanayin.

charts.areaModeHint: Yankuna masu ɗorewa da daidaituwa suna nuna kowane jerin a matsayin band. Streamgraphs tsakiya da total a kusa da sifili da kuma boye da reference manufa. Wadannan layouts bukatar nonnegative tushen dabi'u. Nuni na lokaci-lokaci yana riƙe da ƙididdiga na asali a cikin bayanan; yankunan overlapping na iya haɗawa da dabi'u mara kyau.
charts.benchmarkHint: Cika tsayayyen manufa daga duk halin yanzu tushen dabi'u. Aiwatar da layin da aka yi niyya don amfani da shi; sake lissafin bayan gyara bayanan.
charts.brandPaletteHint: Loads a ajiye palette a cikin wannan jadawalin jadawalin. Ajiye palette Stores har zuwa farko goma daban-daban ginshiƙi launuka a Brand styles. Chart dabi'u zauna ba canza.
charts.brandPalettes: Ajiye palettes da launuka na ginshiƙi
charts.bubbleColumnHint: X coordinates zauna a cikin shafi na farko. Kawai shafi na Y da aka zaɓa yana rinjayar ma'auni a tsaye. A size shafi bukatar nonnegative dabi'u da akalla daya tabbatacce darajar; daidai masu girma dabam amfani da naúrar nauyi. Reordering ginshiƙai kiyaye wadannan rawar tare da su data.
charts.bubbleExample: Sauya rubutun tare da misalin kumfa
charts.bubbleHint: Yi amfani da daidaitattun lambobi X a cikin shafi na farko. A cikin yanayin da yawa, zaɓi ginshiƙan Y da girman da ke ƙasa; nakasa suna amfani da jerin farko don Y da na biyu don girman. Yankuna suna daidai da girma; sifili masu girma dabam suna ɓoye. Ba tare da jerin girman ba, kumfa daidai suke. Ƙarin jerin zauna a cikin tushen data. Alamar ƙimar suna nuna Y / girman. Axes da sikelin na iya amfani da kwanakin da lokutan UTC don X.
charts.bubbleSingleColumn: Enable mahara data jerin zabi raba Y da size ginshiƙai. Single-series data amfani daidai kumfa masu girma dabam.
charts.categoryAxisHint: A ajiye kowane bayani tare da ba da tazara tsakanin lakabinsa. Kategori na farko da na karshe su kasance da lakabi. Lakabin da aka karkatar yana amfani da layi daya; a koma 0° don amfani da nade rubutu.
charts.categorySummaryHint: Kowane jerin an taƙaita shi daban. Categories kiyaye sunansu na farko, matsayi da kuma category launi. Row count ƙidaya daidaita tushen layuka a kowane jerin. Yi amfani da Undo draft canji don mayar da asali layuka.
charts.dateAxisHint: Yi amfani da kwanakin ISO (2026-01-31) ko UTC timestamps (2026-01-31T14:30Z) a cikin shafi na farko na bayanai. Positions nuna elapsed lokaci, ciki har da rata. Kwanan wata da alamun lokaci suna amfani da UTC akan kowane na'ura. Bounds tsawaita ma'auni yayin da yake kiyaye duk bayanan da aka gani.
charts.donutTotalHint: Jimlar ƙididdigar slices masu kyau kuma yana amfani da tsarin ƙimar da aka zaɓa.
charts.funnelHint: Stages bi jere domin. Yi amfani da dabi'u maras kyau tare da akalla mataki ɗaya mai kyau. An gyara launuka na mataki, lakabi da dabi'u daban.
charts.hierarchyImportHint: Manna CSV ko bayanan da aka raba da tab tare da ginshiƙan rukuni ɗaya zuwa shida da ginshiƙan ƙididdiga na ƙarshe. Har zuwa layuka 50 sun zama hanyoyi na hierarchy da aka raba a hankali. Dole ne a cika kwayoyin rukuni kuma ba za su iya ƙunsar /ba. Wannan yana maye gurbin bayanan da aka tsara tare da jerin guda ɗaya.
charts.histogramFormatHint: Number nuni Formats da bin iyakoki; mitoci zauna kamar yadda countts. Ƙananan ko ɗakunan bayanai iri ɗaya suna amfani da ƙananan bins. Iyakar sama ita ce bin na ƙarshe.
charts.includeNumberFormat: Shigar da lamba format da raka'a
charts.intervalsHint: Ƙarin lokaci-lokaci yana ba da alamun sikelin mafi kyau; Ƙananan yin makirci mai tsabta. Scatter da kumfa ginshiƙi iya daidaita kwance da kuma tsaye sikelin da kansa.
charts.markerHint: Siffofi da tsarin layi suna ba da wata hanya ta bambanta jerin bayanai. Maɓallan bayani suna bin jadawalin. Girman maki sifili yana ɓoye alamomi; girman kumfa yana kiyaye ma'aunin yankin su na da'ira.
charts.missingFilterSeries: Matattara {{filters}} tana nuni ga jerin bayanai da suka ɓace ko marasa tabbas kuma a halin yanzu ana watsi da su.
charts.noBrandPalettes: Ajiye fentin launi a cikin salon Alama don amfani da shi a nan.
charts.noPictogramIcons: Babu gumaka da suka dace da wannan binciken.
charts.noStarters: Babu masu farawa da suka dace da wannan binciken.
charts.noTypes: Babu nau'in jadawali da ya dace. Gwada wani bincike ko rukuni.
charts.observationHint: Liƙa har zuwa lambobi 50 da aka raba da waƙafi, shafuka ko tsinkewar layi. Wannan yana maye gurbin bayanan daftarin da jerin guda ɗaya. Abubuwan lura na asali suna nan a cikin sel da tushen CSV; ana ƙididdige bins na histogram don nunawa.
charts.orderHint: Dabi'u a kowane jerin suna motsawa tare da nau'ikan su. Launukan nau'in jerin guda ɗaya suna bin tsari ɗaya.
charts.percentHint: Shigar da maki na kashi: ƙimar 25 tana nuna kamar 25%.
charts.percentStackHint: Kowane nau'i yana nuna rabon kashi. Dabi'u masu kyau da marasa kyau kowannensu yana kai 100% a gefen su na sifili. Dabi'un tushe suna nan a cikin grid ɗin bayanai da zazzagewar CSV.
charts.pictogramRounding: Alamomi suna kiyasta kowane rabo ta amfani da gumaka gabaɗaya. Ƙananan rabo na iya zagayawa zuwa sifili; bayanin yana riƙe da dabi'un tushe. Ƙara jimlar gumaka don ƙarin cikakkun bayanai. Ƙididdigar gunkin ba ta maye gurbin bayanan ku ba.
charts.pieValueHint: Kunna Nuna dabi'u don nuna wannan tsarin. Rabo suna amfani da yanka masu kyau kawai; jimlar tsakiya tana kiyaye tsarin ƙimar sa.
charts.progressColours: Launi na farko na fentin yana cika ci gaba; na biyu yana nuna waƙar da ta rage. Nuna dabi'u yana sarrafa lakabin kashi. Waɗannan jadawalai suna amfani da ƙimar tushe ta farko kawai.
charts.raceAnimate: Yi rayarwa a tsawon lokacin jadawalin hoto
charts.raceExample: Sauya daftarin aiki da misalin matsayi
charts.raceHint: Yi amfani da bayanan jerin abubuwa da yawa tare da nau'ikan a cikin shafi na farko. Shafuka biyu zuwa shida masu zuwa sune firam ɗin da suka biyo baya; sunayensu suna bayyana azaman taken firam. Dole ne ƙimomi su zama waɗanda ba su gaza sifili ba. Nau'ikan suna riƙe launukansu yayin da matsayi ke canzawa. Wasan yana ɗaukar tsawon lokacin jadawalin hoton.
charts.racePosterHint: Firam ɗin da ke tsaye yana sarrafa SVG da samfotin daftarin aiki. Kashe rayarwa don daskare wannan firam ɗin akan jadawalin lokaci shima. Fitar da hotuna masu motsi da bidiyo suna amfani da lokacin bugawa. Duk firam ɗin suna raba madaidaicin ma'auni mafi girma.
charts.referenceHint: Manufar tana faɗaɗa ma'aunin ƙima lokacin da ake buƙata. Manufofin da aka tara na kashi suna amfani da maki kashi; sauran manufofin suna amfani da raka'o'in tushe.

charts.sampleColours: Yi amfani da samfurin palette da launin rubutu

scale.hint: Iyakoki suna faɗaɗa ma'aunin atomatik don jadawalai masu alaƙa su iya raba kewayon. Ƙimomin da ke wajen waɗancan iyakokin suna kasancewa a bayyane.

charts.scatterHint: Jadawalin watsawa suna amfani da lambobin X a cikin shafi na farko da ƙimar Y a cikin shafukan da suka rage. Jerin abubuwa da yawa suna raba waɗancan lambobin X. Zaɓi Kwanan wata da lokutan UTC a cikin Axes da ma'auni don madaidaicin lokacin da ya wuce.
charts.scatterLinesHint: Layi suna bin tsarin jere. Rarraba ta lambar X a cikin Bayanai don haɗa maki daga hagu zuwa dama. Jerin guda ɗaya yana amfani da launi na palette na farko don layin.

svgPath.hint: Manna hanya d data ko asali SVG alama tare da hanyoyi, rectangles, da'irori, ellipses, Lines da polygons. Motsa, layi, cubic, quadratic, santsi da umarnin arc suna tallafawa. SVG matrix, fassara, sikelin, juyawa da canje-canje na skew suna riƙe da geometry ɗin su. Geometry yana amfani da launi da kuka zaɓa; zane-zane na asali, bugun jini da iyakar viewport ba a shigo da su ba. Curves zama samfurin zane maki. Rufe hanya tare da Z don cika shi. Raba abubuwan SVG da aka rufe za a iya cika su tare. Da yawa sassa zama rukuni editable yadudduka; hadaddun ramukan ba su da goyon baya.
svgPath.name: Sunan Layer
svgPath.title: Shigo da editable SVG geometry

getting-started.title: Fara
getting-started.intro: Akwai hanyoyi biyar don shiga DeHub kuma babu ɗayansu da ke buƙatar ka mallaki walat ɗin da: Google, Apple, lambar da aka aika zuwa imel ɗinka, lambar da aka aika ta SMS, ko walat ɗin da kake da shi da ka haɗa. Komai sai hanyar walat ɗin tana ƙirƙirar walat ɗin da ba a kula da shi ba a bayanka — kai ne ke riƙe da maɓallan, kuma DeHub yana ɗaukar nauyin gas ɗin don haka zaka iya yin rubutu, ba da kyauta da tattarawa ba tare da siyan kowane irin tsabar kuɗi ba.

steps.1: Ziyarci dehub.io — feed ɗin gida shine shafi na gaba, don haka zaka iya duba kewaye kafin shiga.
steps.2: Danna 'Sign In'. Zaka ga Google da Apple, wuraren shigar da adireshin imel ko lambar waya, da 'Connect Wallet' don wanda kake da shi.
steps.3: Tare da Google ko Apple, kammala tsarin mai bayarwa. Tare da imel ko SMS, shigar da lambar da ta zo.
steps.4: Ana ƙirƙirar walat kuma ana samar da tsaro a gare ku a farkon shiga. Haɗa walat ɗin ku maimakon haka yana nufin sa hannu ɗaya don tabbatar da adireshin.
steps.5: Zaɓi sunan mai amfani. Shi ne abin da mutane ke gani kuma yana zama hanyar haɗin kai zuwa dehub.io/<username>.
steps.6: Ka shiga. Bincika feed ɗin, saita bayanan martaba, kuma fara yin rubuce-rubuce.

tips.1: Shiga ta hanyar Social, imel da SMS ba sa biyan gas ɗin gas — DeHub yana ɗaukar nauyin sa. Walat ɗin da aka haɗa suna biyan nasu ETH ko BNB.
tips.2: Kuna dawowa zuwa tsohon asusun DeHub? Shiga tare da imel ko lambar waya da ya yi amfani da shi kuma gyaran zai same shi a gare ku.
tips.3: Kuna iya riƙe asusun da dama akan na'ura ɗaya kuma ku canza tsakaninsu a Saiti → Bayanin martaba.

home-feed.title: Feed na Gida
home-feed.intro: Feed ɗin gida shine inda kake ganin rubuce-rubuce daga mutanen da kake bi da kuma abubuwan da ke tasowa. Yana goyan bayan shafuka masu nau'ikan abun ciki da zaɓuɓɓukan tsari.

steps.1: Kewaya zuwa /app — wannan shine feed ɗin gida naka.
steps.2: Yi amfani da shafukan sama don tace ta nau'in abun ciki: Gida (duk), Bidiyo, Hotuna, Shorts, Kiɗa, ko Rayayyun shirye-shirye.
steps.3: Gungura hagu/dama akan shafukan don ganin ƙarin zaɓuɓɓuka akan wayar hannu.
steps.4: Yi amfani da maɓallin tace/tsara (sama-dama na abincin) don canza tsari: Zafi, Sabo, ko Sama.
steps.5: Ja ƙasa don sabunta abincin akan wayar hannu.
steps.6: Yi taɗi ƙasa don lodin ƙarin sakonni ta atomatik (infinite scroll).
steps.7: Canza tsakanin Yanayin Zana da Yanayin Abinci ta amfani da mai canza tsari.

tips.1: Yanayin Zana yana da kyau don duba hotuna da sauri.
tips.2: Shafin 'Gida' yana nuna duk nau'ikan abun ciki da aka haɗa tare.
tips.3: Shafin Rayuwa yana nuna rayayyun shirye-shirye masu aiki a halin yanzu.

creating-posts.title: Ƙirƙirar Sakonni
creating-posts.intro: Ƙirƙiri sakonni na rubutu, raba hotuna, bidiyo, bayanan murya, GIFs, da ƙari. Yi amfani da hashtags, cashtags, da ambaton don ƙara isa.

steps.1: Danna maɓallin 'Sako' a gefen hagu (desktop) ko maɓallin + (wayar hannu).
steps.2: Rubuta rubutunka a wurin rubutu.
steps.3: Don ƙara hoto ko bidiyo, danna gunkin media kuma zaɓi fayil.
steps.4: Don yin rikodin bayanin murya, danna gunkin makirfo.
steps.5: Don ƙara GIF, danna gunkin GIF kuma bincika ɗaya.
steps.6: Yi amfani da #hashtags don rarraba sakonka (misali, #crypto, #defi).
steps.7: Yi amfani da $cashtags don nuna alamun kuɗi (misali, $DHB, $ETH).
steps.8: Yi amfani da @mentions don yiwa wasu masu amfani alama (misali, @username).
steps.9: Danna 'Sako' don bugawa. Sakonka ya bayyana a cikin abincin nan take.

tips.1: Sakonni suna goyan bayan tsarin rubutu mai kama da markdown.
tips.2: Kuna iya sake buga sakonni ta danna gunkin sake bugawa akan kowane sakonni kuma zaɓin 'Quote'.
tips.3: Rukuni (hashtags) suna bayyana a cikin jadawalin 'Talk of the Town'.

interacting-with-posts.title: Bayyanawa da Sakonni
interacting-with-posts.intro: Yi hulɗa da abun ciki ta hanyar jefa ƙuri'a, yin sharhi, ba da kyauta, adanawa, rabawa, da fassara.

steps.1: Jefa kuri'a sama ko ƙasa akan sakonni ta amfani da gunkin kibiya a gefen hagu na kowane sakonni.
steps.2: Danna gunkin sharhi don buɗe sashin sharhi kuma barin amsa.
steps.3: Danna gunkin gem/kyauta don aika kyauta a cikin DeHub tokens ga mai ƙirƙirar sakon.
steps.4: Danna gunkin alamar littafi don adana sakonni don daga baya.
steps.5: Danna gunkin raba don kwafin hanyar haɗin sakon ko raba a waje.
steps.6: Danna maɓallin fassara (alama ta duniya) akan kowane post don fassara rubutu zuwa harshen ku.
steps.7: Don posts na hoto, yi amfani da maɓallin 'Translate Image' don samun sigar da AI ta fassara ta rubutu a cikin hoto.
steps.8: Danna kan kowane post don buɗe shi a cikin cikakken allo guda ɗaya.

tips.1: Bayarwa tana tafiya kai tsaye zuwa walat ɗin mai ƙirƙirar a cikin DeHub tokens.
tips.2: Kuna iya saita adadin bayarwa ta hanyar maɓallan zaɓi mai sauri ko shigar da adadi na musamman.
tips.3: Posts da aka yiwa alama ana iya samun su daga shafin Alamar a gefen gefe.

explore-search.title: Bincike & Neman
explore-search.intro: Gano sabon abun ciki da masu amfani ta hanyar shafin bincike da ingantaccen aikin bincike.

steps.1: Jeka /app/explore daga gefen gefe.
steps.2: Yi amfani da mashaya bincike a sama don bincika masu amfani, posts, ko abun ciki.
steps.3: Tace sakamako ta tab: Duk, Mutane, Posts, Hotuna, Bidiyo, Kiɗa, Kai tsaye.
steps.4: Binciko batutuwa masu tasowa da nau'ikan akan shafin bincike.
steps.5: Danna kan batun da ke tasowa don ganin duk posts masu alaƙa.
steps.6: Danna kan mai amfani a cikin sakamakon bincike don ziyarci bayanan martabarsa.

tips.1: Bincike yana goyan bayan sunayen masu amfani, adireshin walat, da kalmomin binciken abun ciki.
tips.2: Batutuwa masu tasowa suna sabuntawa dangane da ayyukan bugawa na baya-bayan nan.

profile.title: Bayani
profile.intro: Bayanan martabarka tana nuna posts ɗinka, masu biyo baya, masu biyo baya, da bayanin walat.

steps.1: Danna avatar ɗinka ko 'Profile' a gefen gefe don duba bayanan martabarka.
steps.2: Danna 'Edit Profile' don sabunta sunan nuni, bio, da avatar ɗinka.
steps.3: Loda hoton bayanin martaba ta danna avatar ɗinka a yanayin gyara.
steps.4: Duba ƙididdigar masu biyo baya da masu biyo baya akan shafin bayanan martabarka.
steps.5: Binciko posts ɗinka, kafofin watsa labarai, da abun ciki da kuka so ta hanyar shafukan bayanan martaba.
steps.6: Kwafi adireshin walat ɗinka ta danna alamar kwafi kusa da shi.
steps.7: Ziyarci bayanan martabar wasu masu amfani ta danna sunan mai amfani ko avatar ɗinsu a ko'ina a dandalin.

tips.1: Sunan mai amfani naka na musamman ne kuma yana bayyana a cikin URL na bayanan martabarka (dehub.io/@username).
tips.2: Saitunan sirri suna ba ka damar sarrafa ko wanene zai iya ganin ƙididdigar masu biyo baya.

messages.title: Saƙonni
messages.intro: aika saƙonni kai tsaye ga wasu masu amfani a dandalin.

steps.1: Danna 'Messages' a gefen gefe don buɗe shafin saƙonni.
steps.2: Danna maballin rubutu don fara sabuwar tattaunawa.
steps.3: Nemo mai amfani ta sunan sa don aika masa saƙo.
steps.4: Rubuta saƙonka kuma danna aika.
steps.5: Duba tarihin tattaunawarka a jerin saƙonni.
steps.6: Danna kan tattaunawa don ci gaba da yin hira.

tips.1: Za ku sami sanarwa lokacin da wani ya yi muku saƙo.
tips.2: Masu kirkira za su iya kulle saƙonni ta hanyar buƙatar kuɗi.

ai-assistant.title: Mataimakin AI
ai-assistant.intro: Yi hira da mataimakin AI na DeHub don samun taimako, bayanai, da ayyukan kirkira.

steps.1: Danna 'Mataimaki' a gefen gefe don buɗe hira ta AI.
steps.2: Rubuta tambayarka ko buƙatarka a cikin shigarwar hira.
steps.3: AI na iya taimakawa tare da bayanan crypto, tambayoyin dandalin, da ilimin gaba ɗaya.
steps.4: Fara sabuwar tattaunawa ta danna maballin sabuwar hira.
steps.5: Duba tarihin tattaunawarka a gefen gefe na shafin mataimaki.
steps.6: Kuna iya haɗa hotuna don AI ta bincika.

tips.1: AI tana tuna mahallin a cikin tattaunawa.
tips.2: Kuna iya tambayar AI game da fasalulluka na DeHub, sharuɗɗan crypto, ko tambayoyi na gaba ɗaya.
tips.3: Tsofaffin tattaunawa ana adana su kuma ana iya samun su kowane lokaci.

notifications.title: Sanarwa
notifications.intro: Rage sabuntawa tare da abubuwan so, sharhi, kuɗi, biyo baya, da sauran ayyuka akan abubuwan da kuka kirkira.

steps.1: Danna gunkin kararrawa ko 'Sanarwa' a gefen gefe.
steps.2: Duba duk sanarwa a cikin jerin lokaci.
steps.3: Danna kan sanarwa don kewaya zuwa abin da ya dace.
steps.4: Sanarwa sun haɗa da: sabbin masu biyo baya, zaɓen post, sharhi, kuɗi, da ambaton.
steps.5: Sanarwa da ba a karanta ba ana nuna su — suna alama a matsayin an karanta lokacin da aka gani.

tips.1: Alamar sanarwa tana nuna adadin sanarwa da ba a karanta ba.
tips.2: Sanarwar kuɗi tana nuna adadin kuɗin da kuka samu.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.intro: Duba kuɗin ku na DeHub a kan sarƙoƙi da yawa, duba ajiyar staking, da sarrafa kadarorinku.

steps.1: Danna 'Wallet' a gefen gefe don buɗe shafin wallet.
steps.2: Duba jimillar kuɗin ku na token da aka tattara a duk sarƙoƙi da aka tallafa.
steps.3: Duba rarrabuwa ta kowane sarƙoƙi: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, da ƙari.
steps.4: Duba ajiyar ku na staking da ladan ku.
steps.5: Danna 'Refresh Scan' don sabunta kuɗin ku daga bayanan kan-sarƙoƙi.
steps.6: Kwafin adireshin walat ɗin ku don karɓar kuɗi daga wasu.

tips.1: Kuɗi suna sabuntawa ta atomatik amma kuna iya tilasta sabuntawa kowane lokaci.
tips.2: Walat ɗin yana nuna duka kuɗi masu ruwa (a hannu) da kuma kuɗin da aka yi staking.

staking.title: Staking
staking.intro: Yi staking na kuɗin ku na DeHub don samun lada da kuma ƙara ikon ku na zaɓe a mulki.

steps.1: Je zuwa shafin 'Staking' daga gefen hagu.
steps.2: Shigar da adadin kuɗin da kake son yi wa staking.
steps.3: Zaɓi sarƙoƙin da kake son yi wa staking a kai.
steps.4: Tabbatar da ciniki a cikin walat ɗin ku (walat na waje) ko kuma yana sarrafa kansa (shiga ta zamantakewa).
steps.5: Duba adadin ku na staking da duk wani lada da ke jiran ku.
steps.6: Don cire staking, shigar da adadin kuma tabbatar da cinikin cire staking.

tips.1: Staking yana ƙara nauyin zaɓen ku a cikin shawarwarin mulki.
tips.2: Masu amfani da Social-login ba sa buƙatar gas don yin staking — yana da gasless.
tips.3: Kuna iya yin staking a kan sarƙoƙi da yawa a lokaci guda.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.intro: Gani waye ke kan gaba! Leaderboard yana jera masu amfani ta hanyar kuɗi, kashe kuɗi na yau da kullun, da kuma batutuwan da ke tasowa.

steps.1: Je zuwa shafin 'Leaderboard' daga gefen hagu.
steps.2: Canza tsakanin shafuka: Balance, Daily Spent, da Talk of the Town.
steps.3: Shafin Balance yana jera masu amfani ta hanyar jimillar kuɗin ku na token.
steps.4: Shafin Daily Spent yana nuna wanda ya fi aiki wajen ba da kuɗi a cikin awanni 24 da suka gabata.
steps.5: Talk of the Town yana nuna batutuwa/rukuni mafi muhawara.
steps.6: Danna kan kowane mai amfani don ziyarci bayanan sa.
steps.7: Leaderboard yana sabuntawa lokaci-lokaci a duk tsawon yini.

tips.1: Jerin na yau da kullun suna sake saitawa kowane awanni 24.
tips.2: Talk of the Town yana lura da rukuni na kalma ɗaya daga hashtags.

command-centre.title: Command Centre
command-centre.intro: Bayanin dashboard da ke nuna muhimman ma'auni da ayyukan dandalinku a kallo.

steps.1: Danna 'Command Centre' a gefen mashaya.
steps.2: Duba taƙaitaccen bayanin martabarku, gami da yawan abubuwan da kuka yi, masu biyanku, da kuma hulɗa.
steps.3: Duba ayyukan da kuka yi kwanan nan da kuma batutuwan da ke tasowa.
steps.4: Samun hanyoyin haɗi masu sauri zuwa fasalulluka da ake amfani da su akai-akai.

tips.1: Command Centre yana baku damar ganin DeHub ɗin ku gaba ɗaya.

governance.title: Gudanarwa
governance.intro: Shiga cikin gudanarwar dandalin ta hanyar ƙirƙirar tayi da kuma zaɓen shawarwarin al'umma.

steps.1: Je zuwa 'Governance' daga gefen mashaya.
steps.2: Bincika tayi masu aiki da al'umma suka gabatar.
steps.3: Danna tayi don karanta cikakken bayani da tattaunawarsu.
steps.4: Zaɓi tayi ta amfani da maɓallan thumbs up/down — nauyin zaɓinku ya dogara da adadin DeHub tokens da kuka ajiye.
steps.5: Bar sharhi akan tayi don tattaunawa da al'umma.
steps.6: Gabatar da tayinku ta hanyar danna maɓallin 'Create Proposal'.

tips.1: Ƙarfin zaɓinku ana ƙididdige shi ta adadin tokens da kuka ajiye.
tips.2: Masu rike da Badge na iya samun ƙarin nauyin zaɓe.
tips.3: Tayi suna wuce ta matakai: Aiki → Wucewa/Karyewa.

bookmarks.title: Alamomi
bookmarks.intro: Ajiye abubuwan da kuka yi a cikin alamominku don samun sauƙin samun su daga baya.

steps.1: Danna alamar alamar akan kowane abin da kuka yi don adana shi.
steps.2: Je zuwa 'Bookmarks' a gefen mashaya don duba duk abubuwan da kuka adana.
steps.3: Danna abin da aka yiwa alama don duba shi gaba ɗaya.
steps.4: Cire alama ta hanyar danna alamar alamar sake.

tips.1: Alamomi sirri ne — ku kaɗai za ku iya ganin abubuwan da kuka adana.
tips.2: Babu iyaka ga adadin abubuwan da za ku iya yiwa alama.

settings.title: Saituna
settings.intro: Tsara ƙwarewar DeHub ɗinku tare da harshe, sirri, da zaɓuɓɓukan nuni.

steps.1: Danna 'Settings' a gefen mashaya.
steps.2: Canza harshen nuni daga zaɓin harshe.
steps.3: Gyara saitunan sirri: sarrafa wanene zai ga adadin masu biyanku da jerin abubuwan da kuke bi.
steps.4: Saita zaɓin bayyanar bayanan ku na tsoho.
steps.5: Gudanar da zaɓin sanarwa.

tips.1: DeHub yana goyan bayan harsuna da yawa — duk abin da ke cikin shafin yana fassara.
tips.2: Saitunan sirri suna aiki nan take.

posting-allowance.title: Yawan Bayanan Ku na Rana
posting-allowance.intro: Bayarwa kyauta ce kowace rana har zuwa iyaka wanda ke girma tare da lambar yabo ta staking ɗin ku. Kowace mutum yana farawa da bayanan rubutu goma da gigabyte ɗaya na bidiyo, hotuna da odiyo kowace rana. Wuce ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan kuma sauran wannan ranar ana biyan su da kuɗin DeHub — kawai akan ɓangaren da ya wuce iyaka.

steps.1: Yi bayani kamar yadda aka saba. A cikin iyaka babu abin da ake caji kuma babu abin da ake tambaya daga gare ku.
steps.2: Bayanan rubutu da kafofin watsa labarai rukunin raba ne, don haka yinin da aka ciyar da loda bidiyo har yanzu yana barin duk bayanan rubutu goma kyauta.
steps.3: Lokacin da wani bayani zai wuce iyaka, aikace-aikacen yana ƙididdige shi da farko kuma yana duba walat ɗin ku zai iya rufe shi kafin komai ya loda.
steps.4: Bayanan yana bugawa kamar yadda yake a cikin iyaka — bugawa ba ta jira biya ba.
steps.5: Sannan kuna amincewa da canja wuri ɗaya don wannan bayanin kawai, wanda aka tsai da shi akan wanne daga cikin Base ko BNB Chain ke da isassun kuɗin DeHub.
steps.6: Duk rukunin suna sake saitawa da tsakar dare UTC.

tips.1: Wucewa yana daidai da yawa: 200 MB da ya wuce iyaka yana kashe 200 MB, ba duka gigabyte ɗaya ba.
tips.2: Sake bugawa, sharhi, martani, ba da kuɗi da saƙonni ba su da tsada kuma ba sa taɓa iyaka.
tips.3: Karyata biyan kuɗin kuma bayanin ya kasance — adadin yana toshe bayanin ku na gaba da za a biya har sai an tsai da shi. Iyakacin kyauta na gobe koyaushe naku ne.
tips.4: Alamar staking tana haɓaka iyaka kyauta kuma tana rage farashin duk abin da ya wuce shi.

reactions-and-safety.title: Martani, Rushewa & Abubuwan da Ba su Dace ba
reactions-and-safety.intro: Akwai martani tara a bayan maɓallin kamar; da kuma saitin sarrafawa don yanke hukunci kan abin da kuke gani da kuma wanene zai iya samun ku.

steps.1: Riƙe yatsa sama akan kowane bayani don buɗe tire na martani: kamar, so, girmamawa, zafi, lol, baƙin ciki, kuka, rashin so da najasa.
steps.2: Tushen bakwai masu kyau suna ƙidaya zuwa jimlar son bayanin; rashin so da najasa suna ƙidaya a kansa.
steps.3: Martanin ku yana da nauyi ta lambar yabo ta staking ɗin ku, don haka martanin mai riƙe da lambar yabo yana motsa ƙididdigar fiye da kaɗa ɗaya.
steps.4: Danna X a cikin kan bayanin don toshe marubucinsa — suna fita daga abincin ku nan take.
steps.5: Masu ƙirƙirar suna yiwa bayanan su alama a matsayin manya yayin da suke tsarawa; waɗannan bayanan suna kasancewa a waje da shafin gida na jama'a.
steps.6: Don ganin manyan bayanan ko'ina, kunna 'Nuna abubuwan da ba su dace ba' a Saituna.

tips.1: Babban bayani har yanzu yana da cikakken bayani akan bayanin mai ƙirƙira da kuma ga mutanen da ke bin sa.
tips.2: Tsayawa daga bayanin ya fi toshewa nisa kuma yana yanke saƙon ma.
tips.3: Tire na martani yana nuna wanda ya yi martani da abin da, don haka zaku iya ganin dakin maimakon lambobi kawai.

stages.title: Matakai (Dakunan Odiyo Kai tsaye)
stages.intro: Matakai dakunan odiyo ne kai tsaye da aka gina a cikin DeHub. Mai watsa labarai yana buɗe daki, yana kawo masu magana sama, kuma kowa na iya shiga don sauraro daga shafin Matakai ko hanyar haɗin da aka raba.

steps.1: Bude 'Matakai' a cikin sandar gefe don ganin abin da ke gudana yanzu da abin da aka tsara.
steps.2: Danna wani mataki kai tsaye don shiga a matsayin mai sauraro, ko saita tuni a kan wanda aka tsara kuma a gaya maka lokacin da ya fara.
steps.3: Fara naku daga shafi ɗaya — za ku iya zuwa kai tsaye daga burauza, ba tare da OBS ko maɓallin watsawa ba.
steps.4: A matsayinka na mai masauki, kawo masu magana a kan mataki, ka kashe ko ka cire su, ka raba allonka, kuma ka sarrafa allon sauti.
steps.5: Masu sauraro suna aika martani kai tsaye kuma suna magana a cikin tattaunawar ɗakin ba tare da zuwa kan mataki ba.
steps.6: Kowane mataki yana yin rikodin, kuma rikodin yana sake kunnawa bayan haka daga katin da ya bayyana a kai.

tips.1: Kallon kai tsaye yana ba da rubutu ga kowane mai magana kuma yana fassara zuwa kowace harshe da kake karantawa a ciki.
tips.2: Fassarar kai tsaye na iya magana da ɗakin da babbar murya ta mai masauki ta mallakar murya, ana biyan kuɗi ta minti a cikin kuɗin DeHub.
tips.3: Masu masauki za su iya sanya tashar rediyo ta watsawa ko kunna waƙoƙin nasu tsakanin tattaunawa.
tips.4: Ƙaramin ɗan wasa yana ci gaba da ɗakin a kusurwa yayin da kake bincika sauran aikace-aikacen.

communities.title: Kungiyoyi & Abubuwan da suka faru
communities.intro: Kungiyoyi wuraren da membobi ke gudanarwa tare da nasu abinci, membobi da ayyuka. Abubuwan da suka faru suna ƙara tsarin da aka tsara lokaci a saman su.

steps.1: Bude 'Kungiyoyi' a gefen hagu kuma bincika na jama'a.
steps.2: Shiga cikin danna ɗaya. Sabon aiki yana bayyana a matsayin alamar da ba a karanta ba a cikin kewayawa.
steps.3: Yi post, tattauna, gudanar da zaɓe kuma ba da kyauta a cikin abincin kowace kungiya.
steps.4: Masu mallakar kungiya suna sarrafa sararin su kuma za su iya ba da izinin gudanarwa ga wasu.
steps.5: Bude 'Abubuwan da suka faru' don tsarin da aka tsara, tare da cikakken shafi ga kowane taron da za ku iya bi da shi kai tsaye.

tips.1: Tattaunawar kungiya tana goyan bayan @mentions da @here, don haka post zai iya isa ga dakin.
tips.2: Hanyar gayyata tana ba ka damar kawo mutane kai tsaye cikin kungiya.

arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.intro: Wasanni biyar suna gudana a cikin DeHub a cikin shafin burauza — babu abin da za a shigar, babu abin da za a saya.

steps.1: Bude 'Arcade' a gefen hagu.
steps.2: Zaɓi wasa: King's Gambit (3D chess tare da kan layi Elo ladder), Claude of Duty (mai harbi wanda ke samar da nasa fasaha yayin da yake lodawa), Jungle Trail (procedural rainforest walk), Street Slayer (beat 'em up da aka yi don DeHub) ko Chartopia (wurin ciniki mai tafiya).
steps.3: Yi wasa a cikin shafin. King's Gambit da Street Slayer suna riƙe da jadawalin jagoranci.
steps.4: Chartopia kuma yana gudana a cikin VR headset ta hanyar WebXR.

tips.1: Biyu daga cikinsu suna ɓoye a cikin jigogin bayyanar — saita aikace-aikacen zuwa War don Claude of Duty, ko Jungle don Jungle Trail.
tips.2: Kowane wasa yana da nasa katin raba, don haka hanyar haɗi zuwa ɗaya yana buɗewa yadda ya kamata a duk inda ka aika shi.

bounties-stores.title: Bounties & Stores
bounties-stores.intro: Hanyoyi biyu don juya dandalin zuwa samun kuɗi: aika ko karɓar kyauta, ko buɗe kantin sayar da sayarwa ga masu sauraron ku.

steps.1: Bude 'Bounties' don bincika buɗaɗɗen aiki, ta hanyar nau'i ko kuɗi.
steps.2: Karɓi ɗaya, yi aikin, kuma ka aika shi don tattara lada — kowa na iya zama mai farauta, ba a buƙatar aikace-aikace.
steps.3: Saka kyautarka tare da taƙaitaccen bayani da kuma ladan kuɗi a cikin DeHub ko USDC. Yana shiga cikin ajiyar kuɗi a lokacin da kuka sanya shi.
steps.4: Bude 'Stores' don kafa shagon sayarwa tare da shafinsa, alamarsa, da kuma jeri.
steps.5: Ana tsara farashin samfurori kuma ana biya su a cikin kuɗin DeHub ta hanyar walat ɗin da aka gina, ba tare da wani tsarin biya na waje ba.

tips.1: An tsara kyaututtuka zuwa Social Media, Clipping, da kuma Contracts.
tips.2: Hanyar jayayya tana warware rashin fahimta kan bayarwa, don haka ajiyar kuɗi koyaushe tana warwarewa cikin adalci.
tips.3: Masu kirkira suna amfani da kyaututtuka don haɓaka al'umma — rabawa, gajerun shirye-shirye, da kuma martani duk ayyuka ne masu inganci.

creator-studio.title: Creator Studio & Editor
creator-studio.intro: Creator Studio yana samar da hotuna, bidiyo, kiɗa, murya, da kuma samfuran 3D daga bayani, kuma yana ba su ga edita — gami da cikakken editan bidiyo mai yawa wanda ke gudana a cikin burauzar.

steps.1: Bude Creator Studio kuma ka bayyana abin da kake so a yi.
steps.2: Server ɗin yana ba da farashin kafin aikin ya gudana, don haka ka ga abin da yake kashewa kafin ka kashe shi.
steps.3: Renders suna ci gaba a cikin jerin abubuwa da aka raba yayin da kake ci gaba da bincika app ɗin.
steps.4: Tsara sakamakon a cikin editan salon Canva, ko bude editan bidiyo don layin lokaci na gaske tare da yanke, layering, da kuma fitarwa.
steps.5: Sanya abin da aka gama kai tsaye cikin wani post, gajeren bidiyo, ko jeri na shago.

tips.1: Wani ɗakin ajiya na kyauta yana zaune kusa da Studio don duk abin da kake so ka guji samarwa.
tips.2: Ana biyan samarwa a cikin kuɗin DeHub daga walat ɗinka — kana sanya hannu kan canja wuri ɗaya ga kowane aiki, kuma ana ba da farashin kafin ka biya.
tips.3: Masu amfani masu nauyi za su iya ɗaukar Ultra, Team, ko Scale plan, wanda ke aika kuɗin kuɗi na wata-wata kai tsaye zuwa walat ɗinsu.

buying-dhb.title: Siyan Kuɗi
buying-dhb.intro: Siyan kuɗin DeHub kai tsaye a cikin app ta amfani da tsarin musayar da aka gina.

steps.1: Je zuwa shafin 'Buy' daga sandar gefe.
steps.2: Zaɓi kuɗin da kake son musanyawa daga (misali, ETH, USDC).
steps.3: Shigar da adadin da kake son kashewa ko adadin kuɗin da kake son samu.
steps.4: Duba ƙimar musayar da kuma kimanin fitarwa.
steps.5: Danna gunkin gear na saituna don daidaita ƙimar haɗari (default shine 1%).
steps.6: Tabbatar da cinikin musayar.
steps.7: Kuɗin DeHub za su bayyana a cikin walat ɗinka bayan cinikin ya kammala.

tips.1: Babban ƙimar haɗari = mafi yiwuwa a aiwatarwa, amma yuwuwar samun farashi mara kyau.
tips.2: Koyaushe duba ƙimar musayar kafin tabbatarwa.
tips.3: Kuna iya saita haɗari na musamman a cikin kwamitin saituna.

bridge.title: Bridge
bridge.intro: Matsar da kuɗin DeHub ɗinka tsakanin blockchains masu goyan baya ta amfani da giciye-giciye na bridge.

steps.1: Je ka je zuwa shafin 'Bridge' daga gefen gefe.
steps.2: Zaɓi tushen sarkar (inda kuɗin ku suke a yanzu).
steps.3: Zaɓi sarkar da za a nufa (inda kake son aika su).
steps.4: Shigar da adadin kuɗin da za a yi garkuwa.
steps.5: Duba kuɗin garkuwa da kuma lokacin da ake sa ran isowa.
steps.6: Tabbatar da cinikin garkuwa.
steps.7: Ƙungiyar tana aika tokens ɗin a kan sarkar da za a kai, yawanci cikin kwanakin aiki 1-5.

tips.1: Kuɗin garkuwa na bambanta ta hanyar sarkar ma'aurata.
tips.2: A yanzu ana biyan kuɗin gada da hannu.
tips.3: Koyaushe duba sarkar da za a nufa kafin tabbatarwa.

music-tv.title: Kiɗa & TV
music-tv.intro: Ji daɗin abun ciki na kafofin watsa labarai kai tsaye a cikin DeHub — kunna kiɗa da kallon tashoshin TV kai tsaye.

steps.1: Je zuwa 'Music' daga gefen gefe don bincika da kunna bayanan kiɗa.
steps.2: Je zuwa 'TV' don samun damar tashoshin TV kai tsaye.
steps.3: Bincika tashoshi ta rukuni ko ƙasa.
steps.4: Danna kan tashar don fara kallo.
steps.5: Yi amfani da sarrafawar ƴan wasa don daidaita ƙarar da sake kunnawa.
steps.6: Bayar da rahoton tashoshin da suka lalace ta amfani da maballin rahoto.

tips.1: Tashoshin TV ana tabbatar da su ta al'umma don amintaka.
tips.2: Ana iya kunna bayanan kiɗa yayin binciken wasu abubuwan ciki.

post-info.title: Bayanan Post & Ƙididdiga
post-info.intro: Post da aka haƙa shine NFT da aka raba zuwa 1,000 ɓangarori. Shafin Bayanan Post yana nuna bayanai akan sarkar, ƙididdigar shiga, rarraba mallaka, kuma yana ba ka damar ciniki da ɓangarori na kowane post — akan post da ba a haƙa ba yana bayar da haƙawa maimakon.

steps.1: Danna alamar 'ⓘ' akan kowane post don buɗe shafin Bayanan Post ɗinsa.
steps.2: A saman za ku ga Lambar Token (mai ganowa na musamman akan sarkar) da kuma hash na ciniki — danna hash don ganin shi akan mai binciken block.
steps.3: A ƙasa, ƙididdigar shiga suna nuna jimlar abubuwan so, abubuwan rashin so, kallon, sharhi, da kuma tips da aka karɓa.
steps.4: Sashen masu riƙe yana nuna mashaya ci gaba na yawan ɓangarori 1,000 da mai ƙirƙira har yanzu yake mallaka, ƙari ga jerin duk masu riƙe da ɓangarori tare da kuɗin su da kuma kashi.
steps.5: Idan post ɗin yana biya-kullum-kallo (PPV), za ku ga farashi, kuɗi, da kuma yawan masu amfani da suka saya.
steps.6: Masu mallakar post na iya canza ganuwa (Jama'a, Ba a jera ba, ko Sirri) da kuma gyara taken/bayani kai tsaye daga wannan shafi.

tips.1: Sabon post da aka haƙa yana farawa da mai ƙirƙira yana riƙe da dukkan ɓangarori 1,000 (mallakar 100%).
tips.2: Hash na ciniki yana haɗawa zuwa BaseScan ko BscScan dangane da sarkar.
tips.3: Posts da ba a jera su ba suna bayyana a cikin abinci amma har yanzu ana iya samun su ta hanyar hanyar haɗi kai tsaye.

trading-fractions.title: Trading Fractions
trading-fractions.intro: Kasuwancin Fraction — jerin bincike, yin tayi, lissafin naku — yana rayuwa akan aikace-aikacen yanar gizo a dehub.io, akan kowane shafin Post Info.

steps.1: Bude dehub.io a cikin mai bincike kuma shiga tare da asusun iri ɗaya.
steps.2: Bude post's Post Info page kuma canza zuwa ta Marketplace shafin.
steps.3: Browse listings, yi tayin a farashin ku, ko lissafa fractions ka riƙe.
steps.4: Da zarar cinikayya ta kammala, canjin yana nunawa a cikin shafin Fractions ɗinku anan akan wayar hannu.

tips.1: Samun ɓangarori na post yana nufin ka riƙe rabo daga wannan a kan-chain NFT.
tips.2: Duba masu riƙe da post a kan kasuwar yanar gizo don ganin rarraba mallaka kafin sayen.
tips.3: A matsayinka na mahalicci, sayar da ɓangarori yana bawa magoya baya damar haɗa abun cikin ku.

minting-posts.title: Saka Posts (Ƙirƙirar NFTs)
minting-posts.intro: Saka yana da zaɓi. Post yana bugawa off-chain a lokacin da kuka aika shi – babu walat, babu sa hannu, babu gas – kuma zaku iya saka shi azaman NFT duk lokacin da kuke so, ko dai yayin da kuke tsarawa ko kuma daga baya daga post ɗin kansa.

steps.1: Danna maɓallin 'Post' a cikin mashaya gefe (desktop) ko maɓallin + (wayar hannu).
steps.2: Rubuta rubutun ku, haɗa kafofin watsa labarai (hotuna, bidiyo, sauti), kuma ƙara nau'ikan.
steps.3: Bar 'Saka post' a kashe don bugawa off-chain, ko kunna shi don saka yayin da kuke bugawa.
steps.4: Bugawa ba ya jira a kan sarkar: post ya bayyana a cikin ciyar ko ta yaya.
steps.5: Don yin mint a gaba, buɗe shafin bayanin 'ⓘ' na rubutun kuma ka yi amfani da aikin Mint a can.
steps.6: Da zarar minted, da post samun Token ID da kuma ma'amala hash za ka iya tabbatar a kan-chain, kuma ka rike duk 1,000 sassa na shi.

tips.1: Social, imel da SMS sa hannu-ins biya sifili gas — DeHub tallafawa minting kudade.
tips.2: Masu amfani da-wallet na waje suna buƙatar ETH akan Base ko BnB akan Sarkar BnB don iskar gas.
tips.3: Minting shi ne abin da ya sa post ciniki da kuma royalty-bearing. Rubutun da ba a buga ba har yanzu yana samun nasihu da ra'ayoyi.
tips.4: A kan-chain rikodin ne na dindindin da zarar minted, ko da idan post ne daga baya share daga ciyar.

glossary.title: Kamus
glossary.intro: A m glossary na crypto da kuma dandamali terminology ya taimake ka kewaya Web3.

steps.1: Kewaya zuwa 'Glossary' daga gefen gefe.
steps.2: Browse sharuddan haruffa ko amfani da bincike don nemo takamaiman sharuddan.
steps.3: Danna kan kalma don ganin cikakken ma'anarsa da bayani.
steps.4: Sharuɗɗa suna rufe ra'ayoyin crypto, DeFi terminology, da kuma siffofin DeHub na musamman.

tips.1: Babban albarkatu ga sababbin shiga zuwa crypto da Web3.
tips.2: Ana sabunta glossary akai-akai tare da sababbin sharuɗɗa.

creatorPacks.title: Fakiti
creatorPacks.subtitle: Siffofin emoji, lambobi da GIFs da masu rike da lambobi suka yi. Ƙara kowane fakiti zuwa mai zaɓin ku kuma yi amfani da shi a cikin tattaunawa, sharhi da martani.

multiPost.title: Rarraba posts da yawa
multiPost.intro: Yi post zuwa X, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok da ƙari a lokaci guda tare da dehub. Haɗa asusunka sau ɗaya, sannan zaɓi inda kowane post zai tafi.

multiPost.platformNotes: YouTube na buƙatar bidiyo. Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest da Snapchat na buƙatar hoto ko bidiyo. Instagram dole ne ya zama asusun Kasuwanci ko na Mai kirkira. Posts na TikTok suna fita a fili tare da comments, duets da stitches a kunne.

builder.landerSubtitle: Faɗa wa @mataimaki abin da kuke so a cikin saƙonninku. Yana gina aikace-aikacen, yana karɓar bakuncin sa kuma yana aiko muku da hanyar haɗi wanda kowa zai iya buɗewa. Amsa don canza komai.

builder.step3Body: Kowane mutum na iya buɗe hanyar haɗi. Amsa a cikin hira don canza komai.

depin.title: DePin
depin.noFixedRate: Babu wani adadi na musamman, mafi ƙarancin dawowa, APY ko kimantawa ta gaba. Bayanan gudummawa sune shigarwar lissafi kawai, ba alkawarin biya ba. Duk wani sashe na gaba na token zai faru akan Base kuma ya kasance ƙarƙashin cancanta, ƙa'idodin cibiyar sadarwa da dokar da ta dace.
depin.dhbEarnedThisPeriod: Alamomi da aka samu a wannan lokacin
depin.transcodeImageAlt: Wurin aiki na mai ƙirƙirar gida wanda ke ba da ƙarin ƙarfin GPU
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Ana auna gudunmawa ta hanyar rasidun da aka sanya hannu, binciken lafiya, da kuma ingancin fitarwa. Ajiya kaɗai ba ya haifar da lada.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Ana tabbatar da aikin da ya dace. Ƙididdiga na kasancewa masu canzawa.
depin.hostBody: Nodes suna riƙe da sassa masu ɓoye ko waɗanda aka yiwa lakabi da abun ciki a cikin cache na gida. Ajiya na asali na DeHub ya kasance tushen gaskiya.
depin.deliverBody: Masu watsa shirye-shirye na kusa suna raba sassan bidiyo yayin da hanyar bayarwa ta al'ada ta kasance a shirye a matsayin madadin atomatik.
depin.originBody: Madawwamiyar kwafin tushe da bayarwa ta madadin
depin.availableReplicas: Samar da kwafin da ke akwai
depin.availableReplicasBody: Yi hidimar sassa da aka tabbatar kusa da buƙata
depin.offlineNodeBody: An cire shi daga zirga-zirga har sai ya sake haɗawa
depin.viewerBody: Yana amfani da abokin watsa shirye-shirye lokacin da ya dace, asali lokacin da ake buƙata
depin.protectedContentBody: Sassan masu biyan kuɗi, masu zaman kansu, da kuma biyan kuɗi-per-view za a iya adana su a matsayin ciphertext. masu aikin node ba sa samun maɓallan cancanta kawai saboda suna ba da bayanai.
depin.publicContentBody: Boye-boye yana hana binciken fayilolin da aka adana, amma kafofin watsa labarai na jama'a suna kasancewa ana iya kallo ta hanyar ɗan wasan DeHub na jama'a. Ba za mu yi ikirarin in ba haka ba.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Masu aiki suna zaɓar iyakokin diski, iyakokin bandwidth, sa'o'in aiki, da kuma nau'ikan abun ciki na jama'a da suka cancanta. Sanarwar cirewa tana haifar da share cache.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Bayanan da aka tabbatar da aka yi wa hidima ga zaman wasan kwaikwayo na gaske.
depin.availabilityBody: Binciken samun dama da nasara da kuma sabis mai dogaro lokacin da aka sanya.
depin.validOutputBody: Transcodes dole ne su wuce binciken fasaha da kuma ingancin samfurin.
depin.revenuePool: Pool da aka samar da kuɗi
depin.revenuePoolBody: Idan an kunna, za a saita kasafin kuɗi na lada daga kuɗin shiga na dandalin bayan epoch ya rufe.
depin.deliveryBody: Rarrabawa kai tsaye da bidiyo tare da taimakon abokan hulɗa tare da faɗuwa ta atomatik.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Waƙoƙi da yawa don sake kunnawa mai dogaro a duk saurin haɗin.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Ajiya da aka iyakance, sarrafa bandwidth da tabbatar da samuwa.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Da'awar da ake biya daga kudaden shiga kawai bayan nazarin aiki da na shari'a.
depin.faqOfflineQ: Me ke faruwa lokacin da node ɗin dawo ya kashe?
depin.faqOfflineA: Mai gudanarwa yana cire shi daga zirga-zirgar zirga-zirga. Wani kwafin yana hidimar sashin, ko kuma sake kunnawa ya koma ga ajiyar asalin DeHub yayin da ake tsara kwafin maye.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Shin mai aikin node zai iya ganin abin da suke dauke da shi?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Abubuwan da aka kiyaye ana adana su azaman sassan da aka ɓoye kuma mai masaukin ba ya karɓar makullin sake kunnawa. Abubuwan jama'a suna ci gaba da kasancewa a fili ta hanyar DeHub ta hanyar ƙira.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: Nawa ne mai aikin node zai samu?
depin.faqHowMuchA: Babu wani tsayayyen tsari ko hasashe. Gudunmawar da aka tabbatar na iya samun rabon kuɗin lada da ake biya daga kudaden shiga bayan an rufe wani zamani. Lada ba su da tabbacin, kuma kuɗin wutar lantarki, bandwidth da kayan aiki na iya wuce kowane lada.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Shin software na node tana nan yanzu?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Wani nauyi, matakin da aka dogara da burauza yana samuwa a yau: shiga kuma zaɓi a wannan shafin, kuma buɗe tab ɗinka ya zama node yayin da yake kasancewa a buɗe. Node na tebur mai nauyi, wanda ke kasancewa a koyaushe shine tsarin da aka bayyana na gaba - bai wanzu ba tukuna.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: Shin ina buƙatar shigar da komai don node na burauza?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: A'a. Yana gudana gaba ɗaya a cikin tab ta amfani da ajiyar gida na burauzar ku. Rufe tab ɗin yana dakatar da node ɗinku; babu sabis na baya kuma babu shigarwa.
depin.appSignInBlurb: Shiga don ganin littafin lissafin node ɗinku: abin da kuka adana, abin da aka tabbatar da abin da kuka samu a wannan lokacin.
depin.appNodeBody: Node yana gudana a cikin tab na burauza, ba a cikin wannan app ba. Bude DePin a yanar gizo, shiga tare da wannan asusun kuma zaɓi. Littafin lissafin ku yana bayyana anan.
depin.ctaBody: Origin fallback, encrypted kare kafofin watsa labarai da kuma tabbatar da aiki zo kafin jama'a node lada.
depin.ctaTitle: Kaddamar kawai lokacin da gazawar ta kasance lafiya.
depin.earlyAccessBody: Node mai sauƙi, mai bincike yana rayuwa a ƙasa. A nauyi, ko da yaushe-on tebur node ne a bayyana nan gaba shugabanci, ba samuwa tukuna. Shiga bai taba bada tabbacin lada ba.
depin.heroBlurb: Bayar da ajiya na spare, bandwidth da compute don taimakawa mai watsa shiri, transcode da isar da abun ciki na DeHub.
depin.heroCaption: DeHub yana ci gaba da kwafin asali. Community nodes ƙara m replicas da kuma gida bayarwa iya aiki.
depin.heroImageAlt: A compact gefen-compute node da alaka da gidaje da kuma mahalicci studios
depin.heroTitle: Kayan aikin ku. cibiyar sadarwar kafofin watsa labarai na DeHub.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: Babu wani na'ura na al'umma da ke riƙe da kwafin kawai. Binciken kiwon lafiya, replicas da asalin fallback ci gaba da sake kunnawa samuwa.
depin.nodesLeaveTitle: Cibiyar sadarwar da ke sa ran nodes su bar.
depin.notTrackedYet: Ba a sa ido ba tukuna
depin.privacyBody: Kafofin watsa labarai masu kariya suna ɓoyewa akan kayan aikin al'umma. Ana ba da maɓallan sake kunnawa daban ga masu kallo da aka ba da izini.
depin.privacyTitle: Hosts kantin sayar da guda, ba samun dama ba.
depin.runningCosts: Gudun node yana amfani da wutar lantarki, bayanan intanet da rayuwar kayan aiki. Masu aiki ba za su iya samun komai ba, kuma farashin su na iya wuce kowane lada.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: DePin yana ƙara hanyar isar da DeHub na yanzu na farko. Ƙarin buƙatar aiki yana biye ne kawai bayan an tabbatar da tabbatarwa.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: An gina shi daga mafi aminci na aiki a waje.
depin.statNotTracked: Ba a bi shi ba tukuna.
depin.statUnavailable: Ba a samu ba a yanzu.
depin.threeJobsBody: Operators zabi su ajiya, bandwidth da kuma compute iyaka. DeHub jadawalin kawai aikin da injin su zai iya sarrafawa lafiya.
depin.transcodeBody: Ya cancanta inji juya uploaded video cikin adaptive renditions. Kowane fitarwa ana duba shi kafin a iya bauta masa.
depin.footerNote: Shiga DePin sabis ne na gudummawa, ba kayan saka jari ba. Samuwa, cancanta da lada na iya canzawa.

premium.diveAdFreeBody: Cire kowane sakon talla, kowane tutar haɓakawa, kowane wuri na tallan da aka tallafa a Bincike. Kawai mutane da masu kirkirar da kuka zo don su.
premium.diveBackgroundBody: Rufe wayarka, canza aikace-aikace, tsallaka shafuka — bidiyonka da kiɗanka suna ci gaba da kunnawa. Yi amfani da DeHub kamar aikace-aikacen kafofin watsa labarai da yake.
premium.diveAiTitle: AI wanda zaka iya dogara dashi
premium.diveAiBody: 500 saƙonnin Mataimaki, 150 hotunan AI, da 20 seconds na bidiyon da aka samar kowane wata. Isasshe don ginawa, aika da bugawa — ba teaser ba.
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdQ: Menene ake ɗauka talla akan DeHub?
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdA: Sakonni da aka tallafa a cikin labarinka, tutocin haɓakawa, da wuraren da aka tallafa a Bincike. Premium yana cire dukansu.
premium.faqSwitchPlansQ: Zan iya canzawa tsakanin Extra da Family?
premium.faqSwitchPlansA: Ee. Haɓakawa ko rage girman kowane lokaci — kuɗin biyan kuɗi yana daidaitawa ta atomatik.
premium.faqFamilySeatsA: Mai mallakar yana gayyatar har zuwa 5 sunayen masu amfani da DeHub. Kowace memba tana riƙe da asusunsu, alamomi, da ƙididdiga — babu abin da aka haɗa ko aka raba.
premium.faqTopTierStakerQ: Ni babban mai saka hannun jari ne. Har yanzu zan biya?
premium.faqTopTierStakerA: A'a. Manyan matakai 7 na saka hannun jari suna samun DeHub Extra kyauta. Manyan matakai 4 suna samun DeHub Family kyauta. Cire saka hannun jari kuma fa'idodin suna ɗauke — sake saka hannun jari kuma suna dawowa.
premium.faqPayInDhbQ: Zan iya biyan kuɗi da alamomin DeHub?
premium.faqPayInDhbA: Biyan kuɗi da katin lokacin da aka fara. Biyan kuɗi da alamomin DeHub yana zuwa nan da nan kuma za a haɗa da ragi.
premium.checkoutNotice: Biyan kuɗi yana buɗe dehub.io a cikin burauzar ku. DeHub ne ke sarrafa biyan kuɗi, ba Google Play ba.
premium.notAvailableHere: Ba za a iya siyan shirye-shirye a wannan aikace-aikacen a yankinku ba.
premium.checkoutUnavailable: Biyan kuɗi ba ya samuwa a yanzu. Da fatan za a gwada sake daga baya.

connect.title: Haɗa DeHub da mataimakinka na AI
connect.subtitle: Ba ChatGPT ko Claude damar shiga DeHub — duba rubuce-rubuce, karanta zaren sharhi, bincike da duba bayanan martaba — ta hanyar liƙa URL ɗin da ke ƙasa a cikin saitunan masu haɗawa na mataimakinka.
connect.agentTitle: Kana so ya wallafa, ya jefa ƙuri'a kuma ya amsa?
connect.agentBody: URL ɗin da ke sama don karantawa ne kawai. Ƙirƙiri wakili kuma za ka sami URL na mai haɗawa naka da maɓalli a ciki — matakai iri ɗaya, amma mataimakin zai iya wallafawa, yin sharhi, jefa ƙuri'a da bi a matsayin wakilinka.
connect.chatgptDevMode: Kunna yanayin mai haɓakawa a cikin saitunan masu haɗawa (karanta sanarwar haɗari da aka nuna a can).
connect.chatgptComposer: A menu na "+" na akwatin hira, kunna yanayin mai haɓakawa.
connect.chatgptAddSources: Zaɓi Ƙara tushe, sannan Haɗa ƙari.
connect.nameAndPaste: Sanya wa mai haɗawa suna "DeHub" kuma ka liƙa URL na MCP da ke sama.
connect.askToUse: Nemi {{app}} ya yi amfani da DeHub — misali: "Nuna min rubuce-rubucen da ke tashe a DeHub."
connect.claudeEnable: Kunna mai haɗawa daga akwatin hira na Claude, sannan ka nemi ya yi amfani da DeHub.
connect.otherClients: Duk wani abokin ciniki mai jituwa da MCP yana aiki haka — ƙara sabar MCP ta musamman kuma ka liƙa URL ɗin da ke sama.
connect.guideTitle: Yi amfani da DeHub a cikin {{app}}
connect.guideIntro: DeHub yana samuwa a matsayin mai haɗawa na asali na {{app}}. Kunna shi sau ɗaya kuma ka tambayi {{app}} game da rubuce-rubuce, masu ƙirƙira da abubuwan da ke tashe a DeHub — kai tsaye daga hira.
connect.step1Title: Buɗe mai haɗawa na DeHub a {{app}}
connect.step1Body: Taɓa maɓallin da ke sama. {{app}} zai buɗe kai tsaye a kan mai haɗawa na DeHub a Saituna → Masu haɗawa.
connect.step2Body: Kunna DeHub kuma ka amince da shiga. Sannan {{app}} zai iya karanta rubuce-rubucen jama'a, bayanan martaba da batutuwan da ke tashe na DeHub.
connect.step3Title: Fara sabuwar hira ka yi amfani da shi
connect.step3Body: Buɗe sabuwar hira kuma ka ambaci DeHub a cikin buƙatarka — {{app}} yana kiran mai haɗawa kai tsaye.
connect.prompt1: Taƙaita rubuce-rubuce 10 da suka fi tashe a DeHub a yanzu.
connect.prompt2: Nemo rubuce-rubuce a DeHub game da Bitcoin daga awanni 24 da suka gabata kuma ka ba ni taƙaitawa.
connect.prompt3: Duba bayanan martaba na DeHub @satoshi kuma ka faɗa min abin da ya wallafa a wannan makon.
connect.faqFreeQ: Shin DeHub kyauta ne a cikin {{app}}?
connect.faqFreeA: Eh. Mai haɗawa kyauta ne. Tsarinka na {{app}} dole ne ya goyi bayan masu haɗawa.
connect.faqWhatQ: Me mai haɗawa na DeHub zai iya yi?
connect.faqWhatA: Ta MCP zai iya duba rubuce-rubucen jama'a na DeHub, bincika batutuwa kuma duba bayanan martaba na masu ƙirƙira. Ba ya wallafawa a madadinka.
connect.chatgptFaqAccount: Ba a buƙatar asusu don karanta abubuwan jama'a ta hanyar haɗin gwiwa. Ana buƙatar asusu na DeHub ne kawai idan kana son aika sako, ba da kyauta, ko riƙe token na DeHub.
connect.claudeFaqAccount: A'a. Karanta abubuwan jama'a yana aiki ba tare da asusu ba. Kuna buƙatar asusu na DeHub ne kawai don aika sako, ba da kyauta, ko riƙe token na DeHub.

accountDeletion.title: Share wannan Asusun
accountDeletion.description: Kullum share asusunka da bayanan sirri
accountDeletion.warning: Wannan zai share bayanan martabarka na DeHub, rubuce-rubuce, sharhi, saƙonni da ajiyayyen walat ɗinka har abada. Ka adana bayanan dawo da walat ɗinka kuma ka fara matsar da duk wata kadara. Ba za a iya share mu'amalolin blockchain na jama'a da bayanan biyan kuɗi da doka ta buƙata ba. Ana ɓoye bayananka nan take; sharewa tana kammala cikin kwanaki 30. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.
accountDeletion.receipt: An adana buƙatarku na sharewa. Bayaninka yana ɓoye kuma za a share asusunka har abada a cikin kwanaki 30. Shiga ciki ba zai iya soke wannan buƙatar ba.
accountDeletion.error: Ba zai iya gabatar da buƙatarku na sharewa ba. Ba a tabbatar da asusunka don sharewa ba. Don Allah a sake gwadawa.
accountDeletion.acknowledge: Na ajiye ta walat dawo da cikakkun bayanai da kuma fahimtar cewa shafewa ne na dindindin.

updateGate.recommendedBody: Akwai sabuwar sigar DeHub mai muhimman gyare-gyaren tsaro. Sabunta don asusunka ya kasance amintacce.

walletBackup.backupDescription: Ajiye jumlar dawo da ku ko maɓallin sirri don haka zaku iya dawo da walat ɗin ku.
walletBackup.keyWarning: Duk wanda ke da wannan maɓallin zai iya sarrafa walat ɗin ku. Ajiye shi a wani wuri lafiya kuma kada ku taɓa raba shi.
walletBackup.noPhrase: An adana wannan walat ta amfani da maɓallin sirri, don haka DeHub ba shi da jumlar farfadowa don nunawa. Ajiyayyen wannan maɓallin don dawo da walat iri ɗaya.
walletBackup.phraseLoadFailed: Ba a yi iƙirar shaida ta kawo. Kada ka yi ƙoƙarin shi a karo, ko kada ka fadada DeHub a wataƙila wata device mafi ƙuruciya.
walletBackup.phraseMismatch: Wannan madadin na da wani daban-daban walat. Shiga tare da shigarwarka ta asali don samun dama ga madadin da ya dace.
walletBackup.phraseOtherDevice: Open DeHub a kan na'urar inda ka fara tabbatar da wannan walat don ganin ta dawo da jumla. Zaka kuma iya madadin your sirri key a nan.
walletBackup.phraseUnavailable: Maganar farfadowa ba ta samuwa daga wannan alamar shiga ba. Yi amfani da shigarwarka ta asali ko na'urar don bincika shi. Har yanzu za ka iya madadin your sirri key.
walletBackup.title: Ajiyayyen walat
walletBackup.offerBody: Kalma 12 da za su dawo da kuɗin ku idan kun rasa wayarku ko kalmar sirri. Yana ɗaukar dakika 30.
walletBackup.offerBodyDeviceOnly: Kuɗin kuɗin ku yana rayuwa ne kawai a wannan wayar. Ba tare da waɗannan kalmomin ba, rasa waya yana nufin rasa kuɗin ku.

walletBackup.warnOwns: Duk wanda ke da waɗannan kalmomin yana da kuɗin ku.
walletBackup.warnNeverAsk: DeHub ba zai tambayi su ba.
walletBackup.warnPaper: Rubuta su a takarda, ba a cikin hoton allo ko aikace-aikacen bayanai ba.
walletBackup.passwordToShowWords: Shigar da kalmar sirri na kuɗin ku don nuna kalmomin ku 12.
walletBackup.reminderBody: Kara bayanin kuɗin ku — kalma 12 da za su dawo da shi idan kun rasa wayarku.
